test_requirements.description: Provision several VMs with data disks on the storage class under test. While a background load holds the array at ~80% of its measured maximum IOPS, run an identical 4K random read/write FIO job inside each VM, then take the 99th-percentile completion latency across the VMs.
test_requirements.title: TR-STOR-002: FIO Storage IO Performance

checks.expectation: all requested PVCs reach Bound without provisioner backlog or failure
checks.name: Requested PVCs provisioned and bound

test_requirements.description: Create PVCs (with pods) on the storage class and confirm all reach Bound; measure PVC bind latency and take the p99.
test_requirements.title: TR-STOR-006: PVC Density and Provisioning

test_requirements.description: Create the VMs in a stopped state, then power them all on together so the storage attach path is hit simultaneously. Measure how long until all VMs are Running, and the 99th-percentile per-VM time-to-Running.
test_requirements.title: TR-VIRT-001: Cold VM Boot Storm Performance at Scale

checks.description: Native completeness check emitted by kube-burner-ocp virt-migration: all migration jobs passed.
checks.expectation: Every VM completes live migration with no kube-burner-ocp job failures
checks.name: All VMs migrated successfully

test_requirements.description: Validates that 50 VMs can be live-migrated simultaneously within the SLA window. The implementation uses kube-burner-ocp's virt-migration workload, which pins all VMs to a single worker node, then issues parallel migration requests to move them off.
test_requirements.title: TR-VIRT-004: Parallel VM Live Migration

checks.expectation: all VMs recover to Running+Ready on surviving nodes; ping restored
checks.name: Node-failure VM recovery
steps: Inject node failure (passive monitor | BMC/IPMI power-off | FenceAgentsRemediation)
Volume re-attaches and VMs restart on surviving nodes
Verify Running+Ready and ping recovery per VM

checks.description: Known pitfalls: Infinidat /dev/mapper/WWID udev race (>61s mount); ~9s iSCSI device rescan; Dell CSI requires the Resiliency Module installed.
checks.expectation: volume detaches from the failed node and re-attaches on the surviving node without driver races or long device rescans
checks.name: Volume re-attach on failover is prompt and correct

test_requirements.description: Cause an unplanned failure of a node running VMs, then measure the time until the VM's volume detaches from the failed node, re-attaches on a surviving node, and the VM restarts. Watch the re-attach path for driver races or long device rescans; some drivers require an additional resiliency/fencing module.
test_requirements.title: TR-VIRT-007: VM HA Restart After Node Failure

checks.description: online & offline expansion; capacity grows, data preserved
checks.expectation: Every VM running on the drained worker is Running on a different node after the drain (none shut down or left behind)
checks.name: All VMs evacuated the drained node

test_requirements.description: Place ~50 VMs on a node, drain the node, and confirm all VMs evacuate (live-migrate off) within the time limit. A variant runs the drain with the VMs under active storage I/O (dirty-io profile).
test_requirements.title: TR-VIRT-008: Node Drain Performance

test_requirements.description: On the storage class under test, create a snapshot of a VM (or its volume) and measure the time from request until the snapshot reports ready-to-use; repeat across a batch and take the p99.
test_requirements.title: TR-VIRT-010: VM Snapshot at Scale

test_requirements.description: Pin VMs onto one worker node and increase the number of VMs — and the number of disks per VM — until scheduling or volume attach fails. Record the maximum VMs and maximum attached volumes the node sustained, and publish those numbers.
test_requirements.title: TR-VIRT-013: Per-Node Scale Ceiling (VMs + Volumes/LUNs)

test_requirements.description: From a base volume, create 100 VM clones (snapshot- or CSI-clone backed) and measure the clone-provisioning time; take the p99. Confirm the clone method used is snapshot/CSI, not host-assisted.
test_requirements.title: TR-VIRT-018: VM Cloning at Scale

checks.description: Composite soak/stress gate — the only test exercising concurrent snapshot+migrate+resize storage-load overlap. Binary pass.
checks.expectation: the full create/resize/restart/snapshot/migrate/delete lifecycle completes for 20 VMs in parallel without failure or collapse
checks.name: Full VM lifecycle for 20 VMs in parallel
steps: Migrate VMs from a random node

test_requirements.description: For 20 VMs in parallel, run the full lifecycle — create, resize, restart, snapshot, live-migrate, delete — and confirm it completes without failures within the time limit.
test_requirements.title: TR-VIRT-019: Parallel VM Lifecycle at Progressive Scale

test_requirements.description: Create a single volume, then create 250 snapshots of that same volume, keeping them all live at once, and confirm every snapshot reaches ready-to-use.
test_requirements.title: TR-VIRT-027: Snapshot Depth Per Volume
